# B"H
# Social Migration Studio

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos renews remembered social vessels without pretending their history was born here;
Awtsmoos.com opens archives locally, sends creator video straight to Archive.org, and publishes only after review is clear.

## What this studio does

`/social/migrate/` imports authored Facebook and Instagram history and links to advanced YouTube migration.
Choosing a ZIP, folder, JSON file, or HTML file does **not** upload it.
Metadata is inspected locally. Only media for explicitly selected memories is considered after import begins.

## Facebook export tutorial

1. Open **Accounts Center**.
2. Choose **Your information and permissions**.
3. Choose **Export your information**.
4. Choose **Create export**.
5. Choose the Facebook profile whose history you want.
6. Choose **Export to device**.
7. Choose content, date range, format, and media quality.
8. Prefer **All time** and **JSON** for the fullest structured migration.
9. Download the ZIP when Meta says it is ready.
10. Open `/social/migrate/` and choose the ZIP, extracted folder, JSON, or older HTML export.

Official Facebook export help:
https://www.facebook.com/help/212802592074644

## Instagram export tutorial

1. Open **Accounts Center**.
2. Choose **Your information and permissions**.
3. Choose **Export your information**.
4. Choose **Create export**.
5. Choose the Instagram profile whose history you want.
6. Choose **Export to device**.
7. Choose content, date range, format, and media quality.
8. Prefer **All time** and **JSON**.
9. Download the ZIP when Meta says it is ready.
10. Open `/social/migrate/`.

Official Instagram export help:
https://www.facebook.com/help/181231772500920

## YouTube export tutorial

For a whole archive, use Google Takeout and select **YouTube and YouTube Music**.
Google Takeout help:
https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/3024190?hl=en

Google Takeout:
https://takeout.google.com/

For one owned video, use YouTube Studio → Content → video menu → Download.
YouTube Studio download help:
https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/56100?hl=en

YouTube Studio:
https://studio.youtube.com/

Advanced Awtsmoos migration:
`/youtube/migrate/`

## Video storage: Archive.org direct

Video is never uploaded into the Awtsmoos native asset vault.
To migrate video:

1. Get Internet Archive IA-S3 keys at:
   https://archive.org/account/s3.php
2. Enter the access key and secret key in the local credential panel.
3. Session-only storage is the default.
4. Choose **Remember on this device** only on a trusted device.
5. Selected video bytes travel directly from this browser to `https://s3.us.archive.org`.
6. Awtsmoos receives only the resulting canonical `https://archive.org/download/...` public URL.
7. Use **Forget credentials** to clear both session and device storage.

Internet Archive IAS3 documentation:
https://archive.org/developers/ias3.html

Images and audio continue through the bounded native Awtsmoos asset endpoint.
A huge video still trapped inside a ZIP may need to be extracted first so the browser does not inflate gigabytes into memory.

## Local-first archive safety

ZIP opening reads the central directory first instead of inflating every media file.
HTML is neutralized before detached parsing: scripts/executable containers disappear and fetch-capable attributes become inert.
Archive paths reject traversal, absolute paths, URI schemes, Windows drive escapes, and NUL bytes.
Unknown source dates remain **Unknown** and never become January 1, 1970.

## Review and import flow

1. Open the archive locally.
2. Inspect provider evidence and telemetry.
3. Filter and select memories.
4. Choose Alias, Heichel, and Series.
5. Run server preflight.
6. Generate and review the dry plan.
7. Explicitly choose **Begin import**.
8. Upload selected image/audio to Awtsmoos and selected video directly to Archive.org.
9. Checkpoint only public attachment evidence.
10. Re-run the dry plan with real public paths.
11. Publish through `/api/social/unified-social/publish`.
12. Retry failures without duplicating completed idempotency keys.

## Provenance and recovery

Historical reactions/comments/shares remain provenance and never become fake native comments.
The checkpoint stores serializable public evidence only: selections, destination, public attachment manifests, completed publication evidence, failures, and timestamps.
It never stores `File` objects, object URLs, IA-S3 access/secret keys, or Authorization headers.
After restart, reopen the local archive because file handles are not silently persisted.

See `API.md` for exact server boundaries and capability negotiation.
